solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Old archdeacon's kitchen item

parts.note: an archdeacon is styled the Venerable, abbreviated Ven

explanation.surface: An old churchman's possession turns out to be something from his kitchen.
explanation.definitionFit: An oven is a cooking appliance found in every kitchen, so it is a kitchen item.

clue.text: Loveless bod suffering? It may go to one's heart

definitions.text: It may go to one's heart

indicators.note: something suffering is in a bad way, so these letters are knocked out of shape

explanation.surface: A lonely chap pining for love, whose pain may reach his heart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suffering' rearranges LOVELESS BOD. The heart reference looks emotional but is anatomical.
explanation.definitionFit: Veins carry blood back to the heart, so one such vessel may go to it.

clue.text: Month in which boy gets an illness

indicators.note: the boy is placed within the month, so one word is inside the other

parts.note: May is a month of the year
a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: During a particular month a young lad falls ill.
explanation.definitionFit: Malady is a formal synonym for an illness or ailment.

clue.text: Bug disposed of with metallic superdrug

indicators.note: disposed here means arranged differently, so these letters are set out anew

explanation.surface: An infection is wiped out by a wonder drug with a metal base.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disposed of' looks like getting rid of the bug, but it rearranges BUG METALLIC.
explanation.definitionFit: A magic bullet is a medicine or remedy that cures a disease completely, a wonder drug.

clue.text: The French leading fit group

indicators.note: the French article comes in front of the fit, placing it first

parts.note: le is French for the
an ague is a fit of shivering, as with malaria

explanation.surface: The French side at the top is fit to head the table.
explanation.definitionFit: A league is a group of teams or of allied people or nations.

clue.text: Girl's sanctimonious, right? It brings dismay

parts.note: Di is a girl's name; with the 's it gives DIS
pi is informal for piously self-righteous
taken as written

explanation.surface: A girl's smug piety is a source of dismay to others.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brings' is only a link: the definition is 'dismay' used as a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To dispirit is to dishearten, the verb sense of dismay.

clue.text: The old man, a holy person in history

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father, the old man
St is the abbreviation for saint

explanation.surface: A father figure, a saintly man in times gone by.
explanation.definitionFit: The past is what has happened before, which is history.

clue.text: Seen in post office there's steamy picture

indicators.note: the steamy word is seen within the post office, one inside the other

parts.note: steamy means hot

explanation.surface: Someone spots a racy picture at the post office counter.
explanation.definitionFit: Photo is a short form of photograph, a picture taken by camera.

clue.text: Meals we desire will include this root vegetable

indicators.note: the clue words contain the answer within their run of letters

explanation.surface: Dinners we fancy are going to feature a humble turnip-like vegetable.
explanation.definitionFit: A swede is a large yellow-fleshed root vegetable, called rutabaga in North America.

clue.text: Midlands football team very badly needing ace

parts.note: ill can mean badly, as in ill-treated
A is the abbreviation for ace in cards

explanation.surface: A Midlands club playing poorly desperately needs a star player.
explanation.definitionFit: Aston Villa is a Birmingham football club, commonly called simply Villa.

clue.text: Craftsperson's good girl born in a humbler position

definitions.note: read as craftsperson is, the noun the answer names

parts.note: a lass is a girl
lower means placed further down

explanation.surface: An artisan's well-behaved daughter came from modest origins.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of 'Craftsperson's' stands for 'is', joining definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A glass-blower is a skilled worker who shapes molten glass, a type of craftsperson.

clue.text: Woman in love embraced by one fellow returning

indicators.note: returning means the assembled letters are read back the other way

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: the love is held inside the fellow

parts.note: a man is a fellow
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A woman in love is hugged by a single man coming back to her.
explanation.walkthrough: 'embraced by' puts O inside MAN to give MOAN; I plus MOAN read backwards by 'returning' gives the name.
explanation.definitionFit: Naomi is a woman's name, borne by the biblical mother-in-law of Ruth.

clue.text: Fuller cow, I fancy, having eaten a vegetable

indicators.note: the reworked letters take the a inside them, as food taken in
fancy as an adjective means elaborate, so these letters are done up differently

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A plumper cow, I imagine, has been munching vegetables.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I fancy' looks like the speaker's opinion, but I is part of what 'fancy' shuffles; 'having eaten' then takes the A inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Cauliflower is a brassica eaten for its white flower head, a common vegetable.

clue.text: It's inspired and may give you the giggles

definitions.text: It's inspired and may give you the giggles

parts.words: It's inspired and may give you the giggles
parts.note: inspired here means breathed in, not creative: an anaesthetic gas that is inhaled and makes people laugh

explanation.surface: Something brilliant that will have you in fits.
explanation.definitionFit: Nitrous oxide, used as a dental anaesthetic, is inhaled and causes giddy laughter.

clue.text: Running toward ma, ewe in country area

indicators.note: running here means in motion, so these letters scramble about

explanation.surface: A lamb runs towards its mother sheep across the fields.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Running' rearranges TOWARD MA EWE; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A water meadow is a riverside field that floods, a feature of rural countryside.

clue.text: Man given perch, famous French soldier

parts.note: a perch or rod is an old unit of length
Michel Ney was one of Napoleon's marshals

explanation.surface: A man is handed a fishing perch by a celebrated French soldier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perch' suggests a fish or a roost, but it is the old measure of length also called a rod.
explanation.definitionFit: Rodney is a man's first name.

clue.text: Moan about learner, one offering opinion

indicators.note: the moan wraps around the other letters

parts.note: beef is slang for a complaint or moan
L is the learner-driver plate letter
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A grumble about a student driver, someone voicing a view.
explanation.definitionFit: A belief is something held to be true, an opinion.

clue.text: It's hell before public vehicle comes along

parts.note: ere is an old word for before
a bus is a public transport vehicle

explanation.surface: Waiting for a bus that finally turns up is purgatory.
explanation.walkthrough: Erebus is the primordial darkness of the Greek underworld.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Erebus is the dark region of the underworld, equated with hell.

clue.text: Taut side awkwardly positioned

indicators.note: awkwardly suggests clumsily placed, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A tight flank is placed in an uncomfortable spot.
explanation.definitionFit: Situated means located or placed in a particular position.

clue.text: Die in act, upsetting show

indicators.note: upsetting means overturning, so these letters are tipped into a new order

explanation.surface: An actor dying mid-performance is a disturbing spectacle.
explanation.definitionFit: To indicate is to point out or show something.

clue.text: Audacious between Southampton and IOW?

parts.note: between means in a place, giving in
the Solent is the strait separating Southampton from the Isle of Wight (IOW)

explanation.surface: A question about a daring crossing between a south-coast port and its offshore island.
explanation.walkthrough: The Solent is the channel on England's south coast between the port of Southampton and the Isle of Wight; being between them is being in it.
explanation.definitionFit: Insolent means rudely bold or cheeky, which is audacious in its disrespectful sense.

clue.text: Order money to be paid

explanation.surface: An instruction to pay up.
explanation.definitionFit: Charge means both to command someone and a price asked for something.

clue.text: Privileged to be playing with ten others?

definitions.meaning: ..., as in ... information, means having privileged access

definitions.text: to be playing with ten others?
definitions.meaning: one member of an eleven-strong team is in the side

explanation.surface: Being one of an exclusive eleven is a privilege.
explanation.walkthrough: Football and cricket teams have eleven players, so a player plus ten others is in the side.
explanation.definitionFit: Inside means privy to confidential knowledge, and read as two words means in the team.

clue.text: Female takes long time in cooking steak

indicators.note: cooking means being prepared or concocted, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A woman spends ages in the kitchen preparing a steak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'takes' is only a link joining the female letter to the anagram signalled by 'cooking'.
explanation.definitionFit: Filet mignon is a small tender cut of beef tenderloin, a premium steak.

clue.text: Rain drastic? He may be involved!

definitions.text: Rain drastic? He may be involved!

indicators.note: involved means enclosed, so the answer lies within the words before it

explanation.surface: Torrential rain: is a god behind it?
explanation.walkthrough: Indra is the Hindu god of rain and thunder, so the whole clue is also the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Indra, king of the Vedic gods, wields thunderbolts and brings rain, so he would be behind a deluge.

clue.text: English male encountered tourist in the South West

parts.note: met means encountered

explanation.surface: An Englishman bumps into a holidaymaker down in Cornwall.
explanation.walkthrough: In Cornwall, in England's South West, emmet is a dialect word for a tourist.
explanation.definitionFit: Emmet, literally an old word for ant, is Cornish slang for a visiting tourist.

clue.text: German writer that often gets cut

definitions.meaning: Günter ... was a Nobel-winning German novelist

explanation.surface: A German author whose work is frequently edited down.
explanation.definitionFit: Grass names both the author of The Tin Drum and the lawn plant that is regularly mown.

clue.text: Underground river doesn't shift, we hear

indicators.note: we hear signals a word that sounds like the entry

parts.note: something that sticks doesn't move

explanation.surface: A subterranean stream that stays put, apparently.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the Styx is the river of the underworld crossed by the dead.

clue.text: Overshadowing a stupid sailor

parts.note: dumb means stupid
a rating is a non-officer sailor

explanation.surface: A dim seaman is being outshone by others.
explanation.definitionFit: To adumbrate can mean to overshadow or obscure, so adumbrating is overshadowing.

clue.text: Pain from past coming to American city

parts.note: ago means in the past
NY is the abbreviation for New York

explanation.surface: Old hurts resurface on arriving in a US city.
explanation.definitionFit: Agony is intense physical or mental pain.

clue.text: Inclination to give peculiar talk

definitions.meaning: jargon or slang peculiar to a group

explanation.surface: A tendency to speak in odd jargon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'peculiar' means belonging to a particular group, not strange.
explanation.definitionFit: Cant means both a slant or tilt and the private jargon of a particular group.

clue.text: A girl's going round the East to find Greek hero

indicators.note: the girl's name circles the east letter

parts.note: Ena is a girl's name; with the 's it gives ENAS
E is the abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: A girl travels around the East in search of a classical hero.
explanation.walkthrough: Aeneas was strictly a Trojan hero, but he belongs to Greek myth, which the setter allows.
explanation.definitionFit: Aeneas is the hero of Virgil's Aeneid, a figure from Greek legend of the Trojan War.
